meta.name: pr-lens
meta.description: WHAT: Draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram, on its own or in a pull request. WHEN: asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. KEYWORDS: PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, visualise, visualize, pull request

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动画成会动的架构图,让 PR 一眼看懂
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要跟同事讲清一次改动或一套系统怎么运转。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a code change into an animated architecture diagram
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often explain a change or a system to teammates.

howto.what: 把代码改动或代码库的某部分画成带动画的架构图或数据流图:先写成 JSON 文档,校验通过后渲染成 SVG。可直接给你 canvas 链接,或在有 PR 时把图附到 PR 描述里。
howto.when: 当你要求画图、可视化或解释某次改动或某个系统,或希望 PR 带上示意图时触发(关键词:PR Lens、diagram、data flow 等)。

say.text: 把这次的代码改动画成架构图,给我 canvas 链接
say.note: 先读 diff,渲染后推送画布并返回链接

say.text: 给这个 PR 的描述里加一张架构图
say.note: 图会附到 PR 描述开头

say.text: 把那个节点改个名字,再重新推一次
say.note: 链接不变,同一画布原地更新

howto.what_en: Claude turns a code change or part of a codebase into an animated architecture or data-flow diagram: it writes a JSON document, validates it, renders SVGs, and can hand you a canvas link or attach the diagram to a pull request.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram (keywords: PR Lens, diagram, data flow, etc.).

say_en.text: Diagram this code change as an architecture view and give me the canvas link
say_en.note: Reads the diff, renders, pushes the canvas

say_en.text: Add an architecture diagram to this pull request's description
say_en.note: The diagram is attached at the top of the PR body

say_en.text: Rename that node and push the canvas again
say_en.note: Same link, the canvas updates in place
